rohit-ghumare.name: Rohit Ghumare
rohit-ghumare.bio: Rohit Ghumare wrote 'AI Engineering from Scratch' — 511 lessons that build every algorithm from raw math before a framework gets imported. The Institute's AI-engineering phases are adapted from that curriculum, used under the MIT License. Modifications: reformatted into Sikhi University's course structure, with the code lab, quizzes, and seva-framed intros added.

freecodecamp.name: freeCodeCamp
freecodecamp.bio: freeCodeCamp.org is a 501(c)(3) non-profit. Its curriculum is CC BY-SA 4.0 and its platform code is BSD-3-Clause. The Institute links to the freeCodeCamp curriculum and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by freeCodeCamp.org. Certifications are issued by freeCodeCamp.

sikh-code.name: Sikhi University · Sikh Code
sikh-code.bio: The Institute's own coding courses, guides, and the Build for the Panth capstone — written by Sikhi University, offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (prose) and MIT (engine code).
